text: I hope this month of practices has brought you tangible results, and after completing this practice you may have a question — “What’s next?”… And here before you is a large choice of workshops, intensives, and courses that I have prepared for harmonizing a wide variety of areas of life and inner psychological states. To get your bearings, first decide on the direction — what touches you most right now, that is, causes discomfort, worries, inspires… (where there are vivid emotions, there is energy for development), and then think about how much time you are ready to devote to lessons and practices.
